methods.semantics: S3-002 frozen parser, Timed IR, explicit-state BMC, and separately hash-bound Stage 4 point/interval property adapters
duration and joint timeline removed; action boundaries only

methods.seed_rule: SHA-256 of experiment ID, method ID, program ID, and draw index
methods.semantics: exactly 100 retained finite sampled input/action-prefix executions; no exhaustive claim

methods.blind_inputs: program source plus frozen model summary only; no method output, oracle label, oracle evidence, or counterexample
methods.isolation: each judgment starts a fresh non-resumed ephemeral codex exec in an empty temporary directory with user config/rules, MCP servers, web, shell, and subagents disabled
methods.wall_budget_rule: all five judgments share one 120-second deadline; no retry or replacement; timeout, refusal, malformed response, CLI/service error, and quota-window interruption are separately retained

enforcement.isolation: one fresh subprocess for each program×method
enforcement.memory: Linux enforces the 4 GiB limit with child RLIMIT_AS plus parent peak-RSS monitoring. macOS intentionally does not set RLIMIT_AS because it can fail during Python/loader startup; it enforces the same 4 GiB resident-memory budget through parent ps RSS monitoring. Linux ru_maxrss KiB and macOS ru_maxrss bytes are normalized to bytes.
enforcement.model_limits: full method receives frozen states, transitions, and model-time bounds; parent rejects reported overruns for every method
enforcement.timeout: parent hard-kills the process group at the shared wall deadline
enforcement.logs: stdout and stderr are created in Raw, closed, then SHA-256 hashed; Popen, pre-exec, stdin, and worker-initialization failures are retained per program as exception/null-verdict records and do not abort later records

paired_population: All four methods receive the identical sealed 60-program manifest in program ID order. No method-specific deletion, replacement, retry, or successful-pairs-only denominator.
full_method_interval_speed_bound: For each active move, load the exact content-addressed frozen trajectory, use outward-rounded polynomial derivative bounds, apply the frozen analytic model's joint-to-tool coefficients, and sum active-arm bounds as a conservative checked-pair relative-speed bound; empirical constants are prohibited.
resource_accounting: timeout, refusal, malformed_response, cli_or_service_error, quota_window_interruption, missing, exception, resource_truncated, unknown, and invalid remain explicit. End-to-end coverage retains them; LLM conditional judgment accuracy excludes non-completed outcomes and reports every category separately.
